info.title: Arkham Build OAuth and User API
info.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code API for confidential server-side clients. Client credentials are accepted only in form bodies. Native apps must forward authorization codes to a confidential backend; direct token exchange from an installed app is unsupported.

tags.name: OAuth
tags.description: Authorization, token exchange, and token revocation

tags.name: User decks
tags.description: Bearer-authenticated account and ArkhamDB deck operations

get.description: Starts an authorization-code flow. Every request is sent through authentication and explicit user consent, including requests for an existing grant. Redirect URI matching is exact.

parameters.name: redirect_uri
parameters.description: Exact registered HTTPS, localhost HTTP, or native custom-scheme redirect URI

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Space-separated scopes. profile:read is mandatory; write and delete scopes imply lesser deck scopes.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Non-empty client-generated value of at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes

302.description: Redirect to the arkham.build consent UI, or after the client and redirect URI are trusted, to the registered callback with an OAuth error and state. Approval and denial callbacks are issued by the session-authenticated consent API. Callback locations may use HTTPS, localhost HTTP, or a registered native custom scheme.

Location.description: Consent URL or registered client callback URL

400.description: OAuth request cannot be safely redirected because the client or redirect URI is untrusted

post.summary: Exchange an authorization code or refresh token
post.description: Authenticates a confidential client with client_id and client_secret in the form body. HTTP Basic authentication is not accepted. Refresh exchanges rotate the submitted token and do not permit scope changes.

200.description: One-hour access token and rotating 90-day refresh token

400.description: Invalid OAuth token request, grant, scope, or grant type

post.summary: Revoke an OAuth access or refresh token
post.description: Authenticates the confidential client with form-body credentials. Unknown tokens and tokens owned by another client return success. Revoking a refresh token also revokes access tokens issued from it.

200.description: Token is revoked or was not recognized

get.summary: Get the authenticated user's public profile
get.description: Requires profile:read. Email and identities are omitted.

401.description: Bearer token is missing, malformed, expired, revoked, or otherwise unusable

403.description: Account is banned or the token lacks profile:read

WWW-Authenticate.description: Bearer challenge, including the required scope when absent

get.description: Requires decks:read. Manifests that include ArkhamDB perform an upstream conditional sync and return an opaque snapshot token for consistent batch reads. ArkhamDB failure produces a partial 200 response with account decks and providers.arkhamdb.available=false.

200.description: Source-aware deck manifest, possibly partial when ArkhamDB is unavailable

WWW-Authenticate.description: Bearer challenge, including the required scope when absent

post.description: Requires decks:read. Accepts at most 250 provider-specific targets and preserves request order. ArkhamDB targets require the snapshot token returned by the manifest endpoint. The whole request fails if any target or the selected snapshot is unavailable.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Bearer challenge, including the required scope when absent

409.description: The selected ArkhamDB snapshot is no longer available

post.description: Requires decks:write. Additional request properties, including server-owned deck fields, are ignored. Account creates generate a UUID; ArkhamDB chooses its ID.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Bearer challenge, including the required scope when absent

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Account deck string ID or ArkhamDB numeric ID, encoded as a path segment

WWW-Authenticate.description: Bearer challenge, including the required scope when absent

put.description: Requires decks:write. Fully replaces mutable content while preserving server-owned fields and history links.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Account deck string ID or ArkhamDB numeric ID, encoded as a path segment

WWW-Authenticate.description: Bearer challenge, including the required scope when absent

delete.description: Requires decks:delete. Set all=true to delete the selected deck and its previous history chain.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Account deck string ID or ArkhamDB numeric ID, encoded as a path segment

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Delete the selected deck's previous history chain

WWW-Authenticate.description: Bearer challenge, including the required scope when absent

post.description: Requires decks:write. Creates a child deck and links it to the selected parent using provider-specific history semantics.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Account deck string ID or ArkhamDB numeric ID, encoded as a path segment

WWW-Authenticate.description: Bearer challenge, including the required scope when absent

redirect_uri.description: Exact redirect URI supplied to the authorization endpoint

arkhamdbSyncToken.description: Opaque token selecting the exact ArkhamDB snapshot returned by the manifest, or null when ArkhamDB was not included or available

all.description: When true, delete the selected deck and its previous history chain

OAuthDeckWrite.description: Mutable deck content. Additional properties, including server-owned fields, are ignored.

source.description: Deck provider. Account IDs are strings; ArkhamDB IDs are positive integers in JSON request bodies.

arkhamdbSyncToken.description: Opaque token selecting the exact ArkhamDB snapshot returned by the manifest, or null when ArkhamDB was not included or available

OAuthDeckRouteId.description: Provider-specific deck ID encoded as a path segment: an account string ID or an ArkhamDB positive integer.

OAuthDeckSource.description: Deck provider. Account IDs are strings; ArkhamDB IDs are positive integers in JSON request bodies.

token_type_hint.description: Optional access_token or refresh_token lookup hint

OAuthBearer.description: Opaque access token sent as Authorization: Bearer ab_at_.... Tokens are issued only to confidential server-side clients.

scopes.profile:read: Read the stable account ID and username
scopes.decks:read: Read account and connected ArkhamDB decks
scopes.decks:write: Create, replace, and upgrade decks; implies decks:read
scopes.decks:delete: Delete decks and history; implies decks:write and decks:read
